description.zh:
查询全球加速实例，取值：
- yes：查询全球加速实例状态。
- no：查询全球加速实例和直播链路的绑定详情。
description.en:
Specifies whether to query a GA instance. Valid values:

- yes: queries the status of the GA instance.

- no: queries the binding details between the GA instance and the live channel.

description.zh: 直播中心，取值：cn-beijing、cn-shanghai、cn-shenzhen、cn-qingdao、ap-northeast-1、ap-southeast-5、eu-central-1、ap-southeast-1、ap-south-1，分别表示位于北京、上海、深圳、青岛、日本、印尼、德国、新加坡的直播中心。
description.en: The live center. Valid values: cn-beijing (Beijing), cn-shanghai (Shanghai), cn-shenzhen (Shenzhen), cn-qingdao (Qingdao), ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo), ap-southeast-5 (Jakarta), eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), ap-southeast-1 (Singapore), and ap-south-1 (Mumbai).

descriptions.zh:
请求参数IsGaInstance为yes时，表示查询全球加速实例状态，为no时，表示查询全球加速实例和直播链路的绑定详情。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Set the IsGaInstance parameter to yes to query the status of the GA instance. Set the parameter to no to query the binding details between the GA instance and the live channel.

## QPS limit

Each user can make up to 50 queries per second (QPS). If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this API at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-private-line-avail-ga --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name live --stream-name testStream --acceleration-area ap-southeast-1 --video-center cn-shanghai --is-ga-instance no --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLivePrivateLineAvailGA --region cn-hangzhou --VideoCenter 'cn-shanghai' --StreamName testStream --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --IsGaInstance no --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AccelerationArea 'ap-southeast-1' --AppName live
